llm_response.reason: Numerous signs match recognized scam characteristics: extremely recent registration (2025-08-02) versus claimed multimillion user base and offices worldwide, all registrant details hidden, claims of official SEC registration and guaranteed deposit safety with zero transaction fees, ambiguous privacy and business information, inappropriate contact email, and misleading marketing statements. These tactics clearly fit cryptocurrency scam patterns focused on false authority, unachievable promises, and psychological manipulation.
